cards.name: CC Cylinder
cards.summary: Wraps the layer around a pseudo-3D cylinder with its own light and shading, so a flat image becomes a rotating drum or column. The layer's width runs around the cylinder's circumference.
use_for: turn a flat headline strip or newspaper scan into a rotating drum for an explainer intro
spinning 'wheel of options' or rotating banner for a political comparison
wrap a ticker / text strip around a column for a stylised title card
quick product-style 3D turn of a flat graphic without a 3D renderer
avoid: live-action faces (heavy distortion on the curve looks cheap)
low-res sources: the front of the cylinder magnifies the image
expecting it to interact with AE cameras or lights (it uses its own internal light only)

params.name: Radius (%)
params.does: Cylinder radius relative to the layer size

params.name: Rotation Y
params.does: Spin around the vertical axis (degrees); the main animation control

params.name: Rotation X
params.does: Tilt the cylinder towards/away from camera (degrees)

params.name: Position Z
params.does: Push the cylinder towards or away from the viewer
params.typical: 0 to 300 (believed: positive pushes it away/smaller; sign not verified)

cards.scripting: Rotations are 1d angle properties in degrees (no min/max, 360 = one full turn). Rotation Order: 1 XYZ, 2 XZY, 3 YXZ (default), 4 YZX, 5 ZXY, 6 ZYX (read from After Effects 26.0). Light Color is a colour property; Light Height is -100..100. The effect ignores comp cameras and lights. For a seamless wrap the layer content should tile horizontally (pre-apply Motion Tile or use a wide strip).

verified.note: Image wrapped onto a narrow shaded vertical column with dark falloff at both sides and black around it, clearly a rotated cylinder.

cards.name: CC Environment
cards.summary: Maps an environment image (spherical / light-probe / vertical-cross panorama) chosen from another layer onto the layer as a backdrop that turns with the active 3D camera, like a cheap sky dome.
use_for: camera-reactive panoramic background behind 3D text in a trailer title
fake 360 skyline / sky behind 3D layers in an explainer set
reflection-style backdrop when moving a 3D camera around titles
avoid: using without a 3D camera (it then just shows a static slice of the map)
low-res panoramas: the visible slice is a small crop and looks soft
expecting it to work as a reflection on other layers (it only renders the backdrop on its own layer)

params.name: Environment
params.does: Layer that holds the panorama/environment image
params.typical: an equirectangular or probe image layer (hide its visibility)

params.name: Mapping
params.does: How the environment image is interpreted

params.name: Lens Distortion
params.does: Wide-angle style distortion of the mapped view

cards.scripting: Environment is a layer-reference property: the script must set it to a layer index/ref of the panorama layer (cannot be set from a static spec). Apply on a full-comp solid; it needs an active 3D camera to react to. Mapping: 1 Spherical (default), 2 Probe, 3 Vertical Cross (read from After Effects 26.0). Without these inputs the effect shows nothing useful, hence status needs_input.

verified.note: Status needs_input (needs an environment layer and a 3D camera), so no frame was rendered.

cards.name: CC Sphere
cards.summary: Wraps the layer onto a shaded pseudo-3D sphere, turning a flat image into a ball or globe with its own light, specular highlight and optional reflection map.
use_for: spinning globe from a flat equirectangular world map for geopolitics / foreign-policy explainers
planet or moon shot for a space-news segment (ISRO missions)
turn a flag into a rotating ball for a reel transition
orb / sphere logo reveal in a trailer
avoid: maps not in 2:1 equirectangular projection (continents look stretched and the seam shows)
using it on a press photo of people (faces wrap grotesquely)
large radius on low-res sources (blurry front)

params.name: Rotation Y
params.does: Spin around vertical axis (degrees); the globe-spin control

cards.scripting: Rotations are degrees with no min/max. Reflection Map is a layer-reference property (set by script, not by static spec) and only shows when Reflective > 0. Rotation Order: 1 XYZ (default), 2 XZY, 3 YXZ, 4 YZX, 5 ZXY, 6 ZYX (read from After Effects 26.0). Internal Shadows / Transparency Falloff are 0/1 checkboxes. For a globe, give the layer a 2:1 map (e.g. 2048x1024 precomp) so the wrap is undistorted.

verified.note: Photo wrapped onto a lit, tilted globe in the centre of a black frame with shading and a specular rim.

cards.name: CC Spotlight
cards.summary: Simulates a theatrical spotlight cone falling on the layer: a lit ellipse with soft edges while the rest of the frame drops into darkness; an optional gel layer can tint/pattern the light.
use_for: highlight one leader in a group press photo while darkening the rest
spotlight reveal of a name, quote or document line in an explainer
moving 'searchlight' sweep across a crowd shot for a trailer
interrogation / exposé mood on a still for a news story
avoid: tiny Cone Angle with hard edges (looks like a cheap circle mask)
leaving the surround fully black on news footage that needs context
pure white light on warm footage: tint the Color slightly

params.name: Height
params.does: Height of the light above the layer; low = long stretched ellipse

params.name: Render
params.does: How light, gel and source are combined
params.typical: 4 (default: source lit by the spot, surround dark)

cards.scripting: From/To are 2d spatial points in layer pixels. Render (read from After Effects 26.0): 1 Light Only, 2 Light Add, 3 Light Add+, 4 Light Shadow (default), 5 a separator, 6 Gel Only, 7 Gel Add, 8 Gel Add+, 9 Gel Shadow (the Gel modes need a Gel Layer). Gel Layer is a layer-reference property (script must set it; ignored in static specs). Edge Softness is 0-1, not percent. Animate To (or From) for a sweeping searchlight.

verified.note: Soft warm elliptical pool of light on the left/centre of the photo with the right side and surround dropped to black.

cards.name: Drop Shadow
cards.summary: Adds a shadow behind the layer's alpha shape, offset by direction and distance and softened by blur, so text, logos and cut-outs lift off the background.
use_for: make lower-thirds, captions and Hindi titles readable over busy news footage
lift cut-out leader photos / PNGs off a background in explainers
give logos and stickers depth in reels
add depth to picture-in-picture or scaled-down video windows
avoid: hard, dark, long shadows (Distance large, Softness 0) look dated and cheap
applying to a full-frame opaque layer: the shadow falls outside the frame and is invisible
inconsistent directions across elements in the same shot

params.name: Shadow Color
params.typical: #000000 or a dark tint of the background

params.name: Shadow Only
params.does: Checkbox: render only the shadow, hide the layer
params.typical: 0 in real use (1 only to isolate/preview the shadow)

cards.scripting: DEMO ONLY: demo_settings use Shadow Only = 1 and a saffron colour because the gallery footage is full-frame and opaque, where a normal shadow sits hidden behind the layer; expect a saffron frame with a soft dark band along the top and left edges (the silhouette offset down-right). For real use keep Shadow Only = 0, Shadow Color #000000, Opacity ~180, Distance 4-40, Softness 10-40. Opacity is raw 0-255 (NOT percent; 127.5 = 50%). Direction is a degree angle with no limits (135 = down-right). The shadow is drawn from the layer's alpha, so it only shows on text, shapes, cut-outs or a scaled-down layer. The shadow is clipped at the layer bounds: on tightly cropped layers apply it to a precomp or larger layer.

verified.note: Saffron Shadow-Only frame with a soft black band on the top and left edges, offset ~57 px per axis as expected for Distance 80 at 135 degrees.

cards.name: Radial Shadow
cards.summary: Casts a shadow from a point light source rather than a fixed direction, so the shadow stretches and changes angle depending on where the light sits; Glass Edge mode tints the shadow with the layer's colours.
use_for: projected shadow of a cut-out leader or logo onto a wall-like background
animated light moving past a title so its shadow swings (trailer title)
coloured 'stained-glass' shadow of a flag or logo using Glass Edge
depth for cut-out collage scenes in explainers
avoid: full-frame opaque layers: the shadow is off-frame and invisible
forgetting Resize Layer, so long shadows get clipped at the layer edge
mixing with Drop Shadow directions that disagree

params.name: Projection Distance
params.does: How far the shadow is thrown from the layer

params.name: Render
params.typical: 1 Regular; 2 Glass Edge for coloured shadows

params.name: Color Influence
params.does: How much layer colour bleeds into a Glass Edge shadow

params.name: Resize Layer
params.does: Checkbox: let the shadow extend beyond the layer bounds

cards.scripting: DEMO ONLY: demo_settings use Shadow Only = 1, a saffron colour and an off-frame light at the top-left because the gallery footage is full-frame and opaque, where a normal shadow is hidden behind the layer; the verified render shows the silhouette scaled about 2x away from the light, so the saffron shape starts near [600, 400] and the top/left third of the frame is black. For real use keep Shadow Only = 0, Shadow Color #000000, Opacity 0.5-0.8, Light Source above/beside the subject. Opacity here is raw 0-1 (unlike Drop Shadow's 0-255). Light Source is a 2d spatial point in layer pixels and may sit off-frame; its harvested default [480, 270] is not centre, so always set it. Shadow Only and Resize Layer are 0/1 checkboxes. It only shows on layers with alpha (text, logos, cut-outs) or a scaled-down layer. Measured: Light Source [-600, -400] with Projection Distance 50 scaled the silhouette about 2x about the light (layer corner [0, 0] landed at ~[600, 400]), so keep Projection Distance near 5-20 for a believable cast shadow.

verified.note: Saffron Shadow-Only silhouette projected far down-right away from the off-frame light (corner landed at ~[600, 400] in 1920x1080), leaving the top/left black; scripting note corrected to the measured size.

cards.name: CC Ball Action
cards.summary: Rebuilds the layer as a grid of shaded 3D balls coloured from the image, which can be scattered, twisted and rotated in pseudo-3D for disintegrate / reassemble effects.
use_for: image breaking apart into balls as a transition between story segments
LED-scoreboard / dot-matrix look for election-result or stats graphics
logo or title assembling from scattered dots in a reel intro
stylised 'data-ised' version of a photo for AI / tech explainers
avoid: small Grid Spacing on full HD (thousands of balls: slow and reads as noise)
keeping it on faces for long: identity is lost
heavy Scatter with no motion blur looks like a 2005 screensaver

params.name: Grid Spacing
params.does: Distance between balls (px); sets the resolution of the effect

params.name: Ball Size
params.does: Ball diameter relative to grid spacing (%)

params.name: Twist Angle
params.does: Twist of the grid around the rotation axis (degrees)

params.name: Rotation
params.does: Rotates the ball grid around the chosen axis (degrees)

params.name: Displace
params.does: Displaces balls in depth by an image property

cards.scripting: Popups (read from After Effects 26.0): Coloring 1 Crisp, 2 Medium (default), 3 Smooth; Displace Property 1 Red ... 4 Brightness (default) ... 9 Spherize; Twist Property 1 X Axis (default) ... 13 Fast Top; Rotation Axis 1 X (default) ... 9 XY15Z (enum_labels); only the defaults have been rendered. Twist Angle, Rotation and Scatter Motion are degree/angle-like 1d values with no harvested limits. Grid Spacing 0 is invalid in practice; keep >= 8 on 1080p for render speed. The harvested property set differs from older docs (no 'Instability State'), use only these names.

verified.note: Photo rebuilt as scattered shaded 3D balls coloured from the image (white, pink, blue, grey) over black; subject no longer readable.

cards.name: CC Bubbles
cards.summary: Replaces the layer with a stream of shiny, wobbling bubbles that rise up the frame, each bubble textured with the colours of the source image.
use_for: playful bubble overlay for light-hearted reel or meme content
underwater / fizzy background for a title card
decorative particles over a colourful gradient on AI-education intros
avoid: news / political content: reads childish and cheap
applying directly to the main footage: the original image disappears (use a duplicate or a gradient solid)
huge Bubble Size with Metal reflection: looks like CGI from 2003
cards.scripting: The effect replaces the layer pixels with bubbles; put it on a duplicate of the footage or a coloured solid and composite with Screen/Add. It is time-based: bubbles enter over time, so sample demo frames 1-2 s in, not at frame 0. Reflection Type (1 Liquid, 2 Metal) and Shading Type (1 None, 2 Lighten, 3 Darken, 4 Fade Inwards, 5 Fade Outwards) are read from After Effects 26.0.

verified.note: Layer replaced by overlapping translucent bubbles over black, each tinted with the photo's colours.

cards.name: CC Drizzle
cards.summary: Simulates raindrops hitting a liquid surface: expanding, lit concentric ripples that displace and shade the layer as if it were a puddle.
use_for: rainy-day mood on a still or B-roll for monsoon / flood news
ripple distortion over a title or archive photo for a reflective documentary beat
water-surface transition into a memory / flashback
background texture for emotional quote cards
avoid: high Displacement on faces (warps them badly)
expecting falling rain streaks: it only makes ripples (pair with CC Rainfall)
judging it at frame 0: no drops exist yet

params.name: Rippling
params.does: Number of ring cycles per ripple (angle units)

cards.scripting: Time-based simulation: drops appear after time 0, so check frames 1-2 s in. Light Position is a 2d point used only when Light Type = 2 (Point); its harvested default [480, 270] is not centre. Using = 2 makes it read comp lights instead of its own. Rippling and Light Direction are angle values with no limits. Using (1 Effect Light, 2 AE Lights) and Light Type (1 Distant Light, 2 Point Light) are read from After Effects 26.0. Verified render: Drip Rate 12 with Spreading 200 fills a 1080p frame with overlapping ripples (frosted-glass look, subject barely readable); use 2-5 for distinct rings.

verified.note: Whole photo covered in dense overlapping concentric ripples that refract and shade it like a rippled water surface; very strong at these settings.

cards.name: CC Hair
cards.summary: Grows lit 2D hair / fur strands from every pixel of the layer, coloured from a fixed colour or inherited from the image, with length, weight, density and an optional map layer controlling growth. Needs a layer with alpha (text, logo, shape or cut-out) or a Map Layer to read as fur: on a full-frame opaque photo the strands inherit the photo's colours and only smear it into a washed-out painterly blur with jagged fringes along edges.
use_for: furry / fuzzy title or logo for a comedic reel
grass-like texture on text for an agriculture or farmers' explainer title
stylised 'hairy' meme gag on an object
avoid: full-frame opaque photos or footage: hair grows from every pixel and blends into the image, so the frame looks smeared and painterly with spiky fringes, not furry (verified at Length 60 and Length 150)
fixed Color (Color Inheritance 0) at high Density on a full frame: buries the image under a solid mat of strands
faces and serious news or documentary content: reads as grotesque
very high Density on 4K: slow renders

params.name: Color Inheritance
params.does: 0 = use Color, 1 = take colour from the layer

cards.scripting: Map Layer is a layer-reference property (script must set it; ignored in static specs) and only matters when Map Strength is non-zero; Map Property: 1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance (default), 6 Lightness, 7 Hue, 8 Saturation (read from After Effects 26.0). Constant Mass is a 0/1 checkbox. Works best on text/shape layers with alpha; on a full-frame photo it covers everything uniformly.

verified.note: Still no fur: Length 150 / Thickness 3 / Density 400 at Colour Inheritance 0.7 turns the photo into a washed-out painterly smear with jagged fringes on figures, stripes and block edges and no distinct strands, where the old render added a fine white speckle grain instead; the hair blends into the full-frame photo, so card set to needs_input (layer with alpha or a Map Layer).
verified.second_opinion: corrected: weak verdict is right (strands read as grain at 640px), but the rewrite multiplied hair area about 12x over the old Length 60 / Thickness 1.2 / Density 800 frame that already covered the whole photo, so at Opacity 1 it would bury the photo under a solid brown mat; kept Length 150 / Thickness 3 / Color Inheritance 0.7 / Opacity 1 so strands are visible, lowered Density 1500 -> 400 so they stay distinct

cards.name: CC Mr. Mercury
cards.summary: Turns the layer into a stream of liquid-metal blobs that are emitted from a producer point, merge like mercury and fall under gravity, each blob textured by the source image and lit with specular shine.
use_for: melting / liquid transition out of a shot in a trailer
chrome-liquid logo reveal for a tech or AI reel
surreal 'reality dissolving' moment in a satirical explainer
avoid: default tiny radius: produces a dribble of dots that reads as an error
long holds: the look ages fast
using it on the main footage without a duplicate (the original image vanishes)
cards.scripting: Time-based particle sim: nothing is visible at frame 0, sample 1-2 s in. Animation (1 Explosive (default), 2 Fractal Explosive, 3 Twirl, 4 Twirly, 5 Vortex, 6 Fire, 8 Direction, 9 Direction Normalized, 10 Bi-Directional, 11 Bi-Directional Normalized, 13 Jet, 14 Jet Sideways; 7 and 12 are separators) and Influence Map (1 Blob out, 2 Blob in, 3 Blob in & out (default), 4 Blob out sharp, 5 Constant Blobs) are read from After Effects 26.0; only the defaults have been rendered. Direction and Light Direction are angles without limits. Light Position is used only with Light Type = 2 (Point). Composite the effected duplicate over the original footage if the original must stay visible.

verified.note: Photo turned into merging chrome liquid blobs over black, each textured with the image (stripes, a small round motif) with specular shine.

cards.name: CC Particle Systems II
cards.summary: Built-in 2D particle generator: emits lines, stars or spheres from a producer with velocity, gravity and resistance, shifting from a birth colour to a death colour. It replaces the layer's pixels (the source image disappears), so it is applied on a solid and composited with Screen/Add.
use_for: spark / ember bursts behind a title hit in a trailer or reel
celebration fireworks over an election-win or sports graphic
light particle burst on a beat drop or logo reveal
subtle dust / embers layered over a documentary title card
avoid: default yellow-to-red line particles: instantly read as stock AE
applying it to the footage itself: the image vanishes and only particles on black remain
high Birth Rate with high Velocity: the frame fills with a mat of lines that reads as straw, not sparks
judging it at frame 0: particles build up over time
cards.scripting: Time-based: no particles at frame 0, sample 1-2 s in. Popups (read from After Effects 26.0): Animation 1-11 (1 Explosive (default), 2 Fractal Explosive, 3 Twirl, 4 Twirly, 5 Vortex, 6 Fire, 8 Direction, 9 Direction Normalized, 11 Jet Sideways; 7 and 10 are separators), Particle Type 1-21 (1 Line (default) ... 21 Lens Bubble), Opacity Map 1-6 (3 Fade Out default), Color Map 1-4 (1 Birth to Death), Transfer Mode 1 Composite (default), 2 Screen, 3 Add, 4 Black Matte (verified render with 1: the source image still vanished and particles drew over black). Usually applied on a black solid set to Screen/Add blend mode. Direction is an angle without limits; Random Seed changes the pattern. For true 3D particles use CC Particle World. Verified render: Birth Rate 30 + Velocity 3 + Longevity 2 covered the whole 1080p frame in gold line streaks.

verified.note: Now reads as a proper spark burst: gold line streaks radiate from a dense centre and thin out toward the frame edges over black, where the old render was an edge-to-edge gold mat of lines; the photo still vanishes, as the summary and avoid already state.
